# Jacket size guide

## How each jacket fits

| Jacket | SKU | Fit | Sizes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Light Shell | JKT-COASTAL | Slim: close to the body for walking and cycling | S, M, L, XL |
| Monsoon Rain Jacket | JKT-MONSOON | Regular: room for a T-shirt and a light fleece | S, M, L, XL |
| Storm Pro Jacket | JKT-STORM | Relaxed: room for a warm layer, longer at the back | M, L, XL |

The size goes at the end of the SKU: a medium Monsoon Rain Jacket is JKT-MONSOON-M.

# Jacket size guide

## Still not sure?

- If you are usually an M in T-shirts, you are usually an M in our jackets too.
- The Coastal Light Shell is the snuggest; many people size up in it.
- Email support@tidewater.example with your height and chest measurement and we will suggest a size.

If it doesn't fit, you can return it unused, with its tags, within 30 days of delivery, and order the right size. See [Returns](returns-policy).

# Warranty and how to claim

Our tents, backpacks and jackets carry a **1-year warranty** against manufacturing defects, counted from the day your order was delivered.

# An item is missing from my parcel

## The whole parcel is missing

If tracking says **Delivered** but no parcel came, see [Tracking your order](track-order). We open a trace with the courier, and if the parcel is lost we send everything again or refund you in full.

# Tracking your order

## When to contact us

Please email support@tidewater.example with your order ID if:

- the tracking hasn't changed for 3 business days,
- your order is past its delivery time (3–6 business days for standard, 1–2 for express, 7–14 for international), or
- the tracking says **Delivered** but you don't have the parcel. Check with neighbours and your building's security first; then tell us within 48 hours.

We open a trace with the courier, which usually takes up to 3 business days. If the parcel is lost, we send the items again or refund you in full, including shipping.

# An item is missing from my parcel

## Then, tell us within 48 hours

If it still isn't there, email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- which item is missing, and
- a photo of the parcel and its shipping label.

We check the weight our warehouse recorded when your parcel was packed and what the courier recorded, and reply within one business day.

# Returns: how to send something back

## Exchanges

We don't swap items directly. To change a size or colour, return the item for a refund and place a new order; that way the new one ships straight away instead of waiting for the return. The [jacket size guide](jacket-size-guide) may save you a return.

# Jacket size guide

## Still not sure?

- If you are usually an M in T-shirts, you are usually an M in our jackets too.
- The Coastal Light Shell is the snuggest; many people size up in it.
- Email support@tidewater.example with your height and chest measurement and we will suggest a size.

If it doesn't fit, you can return it unused, with its tags, within 30 days of delivery, and order the right size. See [Returns](returns-policy).

# Damaged or wrong item

## Wrong size?

If you ordered the wrong size, that's a normal return, not a wrong item. If we sent a different size from the one on your order, it's a wrong item and this page applies.

# Damaged or wrong item

## Do I need to send it back?

- **Items under ₹500** (for example a phone pouch, a document pouch or seam sealer): no. Keep it or recycle it; we don't need it back.
- **Items of ₹500 or more**: yes, but you don't pay. In India a courier collects it for free; abroad we pay the return shipping.

For a replacement, we send the new item when the courier has collected the old one. For a refund, the money arrives 5–7 business days after the item reaches our warehouse, or after we approve your photo for items under ₹500.

# Damaged or wrong item

## What we do

You choose:

- **a replacement**, sent as soon as one is in stock, or
- **a full refund**, including the shipping you paid, back to the way you paid.

# Damaged or wrong item

Sorry about that. If something arrives damaged, faulty out of the box, or isn't what you ordered, we will put it right.

## Complaints

If we have got something wrong, tell us. Email support@tidewater.example with "Complaint" in the subject and our support lead will reply personally within 2 business days.

## When we answer

Support hours are **Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST**. We aim to reply within one business day. Messages sent on Sunday are answered on Monday, so Monday replies can take a little longer.

- Write from the email address you ordered with. For your privacy, we can only discuss an order with the email address on it.
- For damage, wrong items and warranty claims, attach photos.
- One email per issue is fine; we will reply to all of them.

# Jacket size guide

All our jackets use the same body measurements. Measure your chest at its fullest point, under your arms, with a soft tape, then find your size below.

| Size | Chest (cm) | Back length (cm) | Sleeve (cm) |
|---|---|---|---|
| S | 88–96 | 70 | 61 |
| M | 96–104 | 72 | 63 |
| L | 104–112 | 74 | 65 |
| XL | 112–120 | 76 | 67 |

If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one if you will wear a fleece or thick layer underneath.
